incident.location: Insured premises, 5219 N Whitman St, Tacoma, WA 98407
incident.description: Supply hose to the second-floor washing machine burst while the machine was running. Water penetrated the ceiling of the kitchen below, damaging drywall, the oak flooring in the hallway, and a built-in cabinet. Water main was shut off within approximately 20 minutes; a restoration company (DryFast NW LLC) was called the same evening for emergency water extraction.

damages.item: Kitchen ceiling drywall repair and repainting
Oak hallway flooring, approx. 14 sqm, replacement
Emergency water extraction and drying (DryFast NW invoice 26-2211)
Washing machine supply hose and valve replacement
